name: mfa_test_access_habits_expanded
description: S8a unit 01: the expanded habits of test_access_habits as the bootstrap, rooms and desktops show them, before any S8a engine edit.

scenario.scenario_brief:
TEST: Access model awareness and habits

A test floor for NPC awareness and habits (ACCESS_MODEL_SLICE_9_1_PLAN.md, section 11). Ten beats, each with a sign. Dana (north, H1) never locks; Ian (east, H2) always locks; Omar (beyond Dana, H3) locks but keeps his password on a note; Priya (south, H4) and Kai (beyond Ian, H5) would never lock but the PC or its policy does; Mei (beyond Priya, H6) has a password you can work out; Tom (beyond Lena, H7) reuses his locker code; Lena (west, H8) sometimes locks. Beyond Kai, the gate hall (H9): Gary holds his door into store A for you; Sara will not open hers into store B with you near. Beyond Omar, Noor (H10) never leaves her desk.
scenario.endGoal: Test only: run the ten habits beats.

contents.name: Staff notice.txt
contents.text:
Staff notice (test floor).

Lock your screen every time you stand up, and never write a password down.
contents.observations: The staff notice, on every staff desktop.

objectives.title: Run the habits beats
objectives.description: Test only. Each task ticks when its beat's event fires.

tasks.title: H1: use Dana's open screen while she is away
H2: Ian's screen is locked while he is away
H3: sign in at Omar's PC with the password on his note
H4: Priya's screen is locked while she is away
H5: Kai's screen is locked while he is away
H6: work out Mei's password and sign in
H7: sign in at Tom's PC with his locker code
H8: use Lena's screen on a leave she leaves it open
H9: follow Gary into store A; Sara's door into store B stops you
H10: Noor's PC is in use whenever you try it

objects.name: Sign: Start here
objects.text:
Ten beats, a sign at each. Dana north (H1), Ian east (H2), Priya south (H4), Lena west (H8).
Omar is beyond Dana (H3) and Noor beyond Omar (H10), Kai beyond Ian (H5), Mei beyond Priya (H6) and Tom beyond Lena (H7). The gate hall is beyond Kai (H9). Nobody here will tell you how careful they are: watch.

objects.name: Dana coffee
objects.observations: Dana's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: H1 Never locks
objects.text:
H1. Dana sits at her desk. Within a minute she walks to her coffee.
Her screen keeps its desktop look. Click her PC: her desktop opens, signed in as her. No note picture on her monitor.

objects.name: Ian coffee
objects.observations: Ian's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: H2 Always locks
objects.text:
H2. Ian sits at his desk. When he walks to his coffee, the padlock shows on his monitor.
Click his PC: the sign-in screen, with no note. There is no way in.

objects.name: Omar's PC
objects.observations: Omar's desk PC. Something yellow is stuck to the monitor.

objects.name: Omar coffee
objects.observations: Omar's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: H3 Careful, with a sticky note
objects.text:
H3. Look at the corner of Omar's monitor. While he sits there, his PC is his.
When he walks to his coffee, the padlock shows. Click his PC: the sign-in screen, with what is written on the note. Save the note to your notebook, then click the PC again and sign in.

objects.name: Sign: H10 Never leaves
objects.text:
H10. Noor never locks her screen, but she never leaves her desk either: all she needs is her own PC.
Click her PC: she is using it. Wait as long as you like; it never comes free.

objects.name: Priya coffee
objects.observations: Priya's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: H4 The PC's own setting wins
objects.text:
H4. Priya never locks her screen herself, but this PC is set to lock whenever she leaves.
When she walks to her coffee, click her PC: the sign-in screen, no way into her session.

objects.name: Kai's PC
objects.observations: Kai's desk PC. The instant lock policy applies here.

objects.name: Kai coffee
objects.observations: Kai's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: H5 Policy beats habit
objects.text:
H5. Kai never locks his screen himself, but this PC is under a policy that locks it the moment he leaves.
When he walks to his coffee, click his PC: the sign-in screen, and no claim.

objects.name: Mei coffee
objects.observations: Mei's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Framed photo
objects.text: A framed photo of a spaniel on a beach. The caption reads: Pepper, our first dog.
objects.observations: A framed photo on Mei's desk.

objects.name: Wall calendar
objects.text: A calendar with one date ringed in red: the day Mei and her husband married, in 1998.

objects.name: IT notice
objects.text: IT notice: easy to remember passwords. Use your first pet's name with a capital first letter, then the year you married, and end with ! (Please do not.)
objects.observations: An IT notice pinned to the wall.

objects.name: Sign: H6 Guessable password
objects.text: H6. Mei locks her screen every time. Read what is around her desk and work her password out before you type: a wrong guess counts. Then sign in at her PC when she is away.

objects.name: Lena coffee
objects.observations: Lena's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: H8 Sometimes locks
objects.text:
H8. Lena pops out for coffee often and only sometimes locks her screen.
On each of her leaves, look at her monitor: an open screen lets you in, a padlock does not. After a reload her pattern starts again from the beginning.

objects.name: Tom coffee
objects.observations: Tom's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Gym locker
objects.observations: Tom's gym locker, with a keypad.

objects.name: Note on the locker
objects.text: Gym locker code, so I stop forgetting it: Harbour-Lift-44
objects.observations: A note taped to the locker.

objects.name: Sign: H7 Reused password
objects.text:
H7. Tom locks his screen every time. Open his gym locker with what is written by it.
Then try the same at his PC when he is away.

objects.name: Sign: H9 Holds doors, and does not
objects.text:
H9. Gary and Sara badge through the gates here: Gary north into store A, Sara south into store B.
Stand beside Gary's door and walk in behind him. Then try Sara's: wait close by and she will not open it; stand well back and she goes through, but the door will not let you follow.

eventMappings.bark: Not with you behind me. Ask at reception.
Not with you behind me. Ask at reception.

objects.name: Sign: Store A
objects.text: Store A. You followed Gary in: his gate opened beside you and stayed open after him.

objects.name: Sign: Store B
objects.text: Store B. You should not have walked in here in the H9 run: Sara's gate never lets you through.

body.endGoal: Test only: run the ten habits beats.
